title: AI-assisted Artifact Collaboration Workflow
summary: 研究 Dropbox、Conversation、Primary Agent local workspace 與 GitHub 如何組成低摩擦 Artifact Collaboration Workflow。已用真實 processed JPEG 驗證 Conversation/local processing → Dropbox staging → temporary download URL → GitHub Actions Runner direct binary fetch → byte/SHA-256/Pillow verification → repository binary commit。Large binary payload 不需經 LLM Base64 transport；目前主要缺口是 Primary 缺 autonomous workflow_dispatch write primitive，因此仍保留 Claire 手動 Run workflow 作為 Human Gate。Public evidence 採 privacy-scrub。
flow: Partial but strong evidence: Conversation image processing / Dropbox staging / temporary binary URL / GitHub Runner direct binary ingest / integrity verification / repository commit verified. Remaining execution gap: Primary cannot autonomously workflow_dispatch with current GitHub Connector; manual Run workflow is fallback Human Gate. Other open directions: Dropbox → Local Workspace binary, GitHub → Local Workspace, bidirectional delivery lifecycle.
